title: Repo Archaeology Relationship Verdicts (.repo-archaeology.verdicts.json, v1)
description: Repo-committed relationship verdicts file for silencing expected mechanical couplings or annotating confirmed hidden dependencies without altering underlying historical scores.

verdicts.description: List of expected (silenced) or confirmed relationship verdicts.

pair.description: Two repository-relative POSIX file paths or glob patterns.

verdict.description: "expected" silences known mechanical couplings; "confirmed" annotates real hidden dependencies.

until.description: Optional expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired entries are ignored and emit a warning.

directed.description: When true, the verdict applies only in direction pair[0] -> pair[1] (default: false, undirected).
